title: tehas state check --json
description: What tehas state check --json prints, version 1: the state store's own answer to its check, whole and in its order. A store that fails its check prints no object. host/docs/api.md says what each field means. `rows` names each table of the store and its number of rows, and a later schema of the store may add tables. test/json_contract_test.sh checks the samples beside this file against it and what the command prints.

rows.description: Each table of the store, and its number of rows, an integer from 0.
